title: lint: field/embedded-sub-fields fix hint still says a child object plus inlineEdit: 'grid' gives inline editing; the rule now needs a parent field group naming the child
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · out-of-scope finding of the dev on #36252 (PR #36280, seat 4 area a4-I). It is code, outside that text-only PR's paths.

## What happens
`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` (around line 1117): the `field/embedded-sub-fields` rule's fix hint, which `os lint` prints to the author, still says to create a child object and set `inlineEdit: 'grid'` to get inline editing. The spec's `EMBEDDED_JSON_TYPED_LIST` text and the rule's own description now say a parent field group's `relatedList` must name the child (#35921, #36224). An author who follows the printed hint gets a child that is a tab, with no lines in the parent form.

## Done when
The fix hint names the parent field group (`fieldGroups[].relatedList`) as what inlines the child, and says `inlineEdit` only picks how rows are edited, the same wording as the spec text. A pin asserts the hint, with an ablation. Check for other lint hints that still teach `inlineEdit` as the switch (`grep -n "inlineEdit" packages/lint/src`).

reach: every author whose object trips `field/embedded-sub-fields`; read from code.
Business reason: the tool's own advice leads authors to a form with no line items.
Reader: domain:devx / packages/lint.
Dedupe: `embedded-sub-fields inlineEdit hint` → none.
Grade: p3.
